title: No More 63 AE2
description: Remove AE2’s default limit of 63 unique item types per ME item storage cell and replace it with a custom configurable limit.

--- ## About **No More 63 AE2** is a lightweight addon for **Applied Energistics 2** that removes the default **63 unique item type limit** from AE2 item storage cells and replaces it with a configurable limit. By default, AE2 item cells can only hold up to **63 different item types**. This mod lets you increase that limit so your storage system can handle more unique items per cell.
[![Support me on Ko-fi](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5c14e387dab576fe667689cf/670f5a0171bfb928b21a7e00_support_me_on_kofi_beige.png)](https://ko-fi.com/nightbeamstudio)
---
## Features - Removes AE2’s default **63 item type limit** - Adds a configurable item type limit for AE2 item storage cells - Keeps normal AE2 storage behavior intact - Does **not** change storage bytes, item counts, channels, or autocrafting - Works as an addon, not a fork of AE2 - Small, focused, and designed for compatibility --- ## Configuration The item type limit can be changed in the mod config file. Example: ```toml # No More 63 AE2 config # Controls how many unique item types an AE2 item storage cell can hold. # AE2 default is 63. maxItemTypesPerCell = 4096
